record.paper_title: $p$-matchings in graphs: a brief survey with some open problems
record.original_question: Let P be a graph property and, for a finite graph G, let β_P(G) denote the maximum cardinality of a matching M such that the induced subgraph G[M] on the endpoints of edges in M has property P. Let G_bar denote the complement of G on the same vertex set. Determine Nordhaus-Gaddum type bounds for β_P: what are the best possible lower and upper bounds for β_P(G)+β_P(G_bar), and what are the best possible lower and upper bounds for β_P(G)·β_P(G_bar)?

evidence.quote: Definition 3.1. Let P be a property of G, and let M a matching of G such that the induced subgraph of M, <M>, has property P, then we call M a P-matching.
It would also be desirable to have Nordhaus-Gaddum type results for these parameters, i.e., to complete the following inequalities ? <= beta_P(G)+beta_P(G_bar) <=? ? <= beta_P(G) * beta_P(G_bar) <=?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\mathcal{P}$ be a graph property (a class of finite simple graphs closed under isomorphism). For a finite simple graph $G=(V,E)$ and a matching $M\subseteq E(G)$ (a set of pairwise non-adjacent edges), let $V(M)$ denote the set of endpoints of edges in $M$, and let $G[V(M)]$ denote the subgraph of $G$ induced by $V(M)$. Call $M$ a $\mathcal{P}$-matching of $G$ if $G[V(M)] \in \mathcal{P}$. Define
$$\beta_{\mathcal{P}}(G) \;=\; \max\{\,|M| : M \text{ is a } \mathcal{P}\text{-matching of } G\,\}.$$
Let $\overline{G}$ denote the complement of $G$ on the same vertex set $V$.

Determine the best possible (i.e., sharp) Nordhaus–Gaddum type bounds for $\beta_{\mathcal{P}}$: namely, find sharp lower and upper bounds, expressed as functions of $n=|V(G)|$ (and possibly of $\mathcal{P}$), for each of
$$\beta_{\mathcal{P}}(G) + \beta_{\mathcal{P}}(\overline{G}) \qquad \text{and} \qquad \beta_{\mathcal{P}}(G) \cdot \beta_{\mathcal{P}}(\overline{G}),$$
valid for every graph $G$ on $n$ vertices, together with extremal graphs achieving them.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is posed as an open problem in a brief survey on $p$-matchings; no subsequent publications resolving general Nordhaus–Gaddum bounds for $\beta_{\mathcal{P}}$ appear to have been published. The status remains open to the best of available evidence.

status_evidence.title: p-matchings in graphs: a brief survey with some open problems
status_evidence.snippet: Open problem requesting Nordhaus-Gaddum type inequalities for beta_P(G)+beta_P(\bar G) and beta_P(G)*beta_P(\bar G).
status_evidence.claim: The Nordhaus–Gaddum bounds for $\beta_{\mathcal{P}}$ are explicitly listed as an open problem.
